c) **Sanitary Works:** Replacement of all sanitary fixtures in the men's and women's toilets; replacement of concealed water supply lines in the toilet blocks; repair of leaking drainage lines; installation of 2 new water heaters; provision of new CPVC hot and cold water lines from the overhead tank to the kitchen and toilets.

d) **Interior Finishing and Painting:** Removal of existing flaking paint from internal walls and ceilings; application of one coat of primer and two coats of acrylic emulsion paint to internal walls; application of two coats of synthetic enamel paint to all doors, windows, and grills; polishing of the existing granite flooring in the main hall; replacement of damaged ceramic tiles in the kitchen and toilets; repair and repainting of the stage flooring.

**3.2 Exclusions**

The following works are excluded from the scope and shall be carried out by the Owner at its own cost:

a) Supply and installation of furniture, curtains, and stage lighting;
b) Supply and installation of air-conditioning units;
c) Any civil works outside the community hall building, including paving of the surrounding area.

**4. TIME OF COMPLETION**

4.1 The Contractor shall commence the works within 10 days of the date of receipt of the mobilization advance and shall complete the entire works within **120 days** from the date of commencement, subject to force majeure and other delays attributable to the Owner.

4.2 The time for completion shall be extended by the Owner in case of any delay caused by the Owner, including but not limited to delay in providing drawings, approvals, or access to the site, or any change in the scope of work.

4.3 If the Contractor fails to complete the works within the stipulated period, excluding the extended period, the Contractor shall pay to the Owner liquidated damages at the rate of 0.5% of the contract amount per week of delay, subject to a maximum of 10% of the contract amount. Such liquidated damages shall be the only remedy available to the Owner for delay in completion.
**5. CONTRACT PRICE AND PAYMENT TERMS**

5.1 The total contract price for the execution of the entire scope of work shall be **₹18,00,000 (Rupees Eighteen Lakh Only)**, hereinafter referred to as the "Contract Price." The Contract Price is fixed and shall not be subject to escalation for any reason whatsoever, except as provided in Clause 5.5 below.

5.2 The Contract Price shall be paid to the Contractor in the following instalments:

a) **Mobilization Advance:** 20% of the Contract Price, i.e., ₹3,60,000, payable within 7 days of execution of this Agreement and upon submission of an unconditional bank guarantee from a scheduled commercial bank for an equivalent amount. The mobilization advance shall be recovered by way of deduction from the running account bills at the rate of 10% of the gross amount of each bill.

b) **Running Account Bills:** 75% of the Contract Price shall be paid through running account bills raised at the end of each month. Each running account bill shall be accompanied by a certificate from the Owner's engineer quantifying the work executed during the month. The Owner shall make payment of each running account bill within 15 days of receipt of the certificate from the engineer.

c) **Retention Money:** 5% of the Contract Price, i.e., ₹90,000, shall be retained from each running account bill. Fifty percent of the retention money shall be released upon issuance of the completion certificate, and the balance shall be released upon expiry of the defect liability period, subject to the Contractor rectifying all defects noticed during such period.

d) **Final Bill:** The final bill shall be submitted within 30 days of issuance of the completion certificate. The final bill shall be paid within 30 days of its certification by the Owner's engineer.

5.3 All payments shall be made by cheque or electronic transfer to the bank account of the Contractor, details of which are provided in Annexure II.

5.4 The Contractor shall be liable to pay interest at the rate of 12% per annum on any amount that becomes due and payable to the Owner under this Agreement, if not paid within the stipulated time.

5.5 The Contract Price may be varied only in the following circumstances:

a) If the Owner issues a written variation order for additional work not covered under the scope of work, the price for such additional work shall be mutually agreed upon prior to execution;

b) If the Owner omits any part of the scope of work, the price shall be reduced proportionately at the rates quoted in the Bill of Quantities;

c) If the statutory duties or taxes are increased or decreased after the date of signing of this Agreement, the difference shall be adjusted accordingly.

**6. QUALITY OF MATERIALS AND WORKMANSHIP**

6.1 The Contractor shall use only new and good-quality materials conforming to the specifications set out in Annexure III and the Indian Standards mentioned therein. All materials shall be subject to the approval of the Owner's engineer before incorporation into the works.

6.2 The Contractor shall, at his own cost, arrange for testing of materials at a government-approved laboratory whenever the Owner's engineer directs such testing. The cost of such testing shall be borne by the Contractor if the materials fail to meet the specified standards; otherwise, the cost shall be borne by the Owner.

6.3 The workmanship shall be of the highest standard, executed by skilled and experienced workers under the supervision of a qualified supervisor employed by the Contractor. The Contractor shall maintain a register of all workers deployed at the site, which shall be available for inspection by the Owner.

2.5 The Owner shall deduct from any payment due to the Contractor, or recover from the Contractor, all amounts for which the Contractor is liable to the Owner under the terms of this Agreement, including but not limited to liquidated damages, penalties, and the cost of rectifying defective work.

2.6 The Contractor shall submit all invoices and bills within 15 days of the completion of the corresponding milestone. Invoices submitted after the expiry of the said period shall be processed only in the next payment cycle.

**3. SCOPE OF WORK**

3.1 The works to be executed under this Agreement are described in the Bill of Quantities annexed hereto as Annexure A, and are summarized as follows:

a) **Structural Repairs and Waterproofing:** Repair of spalled concrete columns and beams in the main hall; application of corrosion-inhibiting coating to exposed reinforcement; crack injection for structural cracks wider than 0.3 mm; waterproofing of the roof terrace over the main hall and the toilet block; replacement of damaged rainwater downpipes and gutters.

b) **Electrical Works:** Complete rewiring of the main hall, stage area, kitchen, and toilets; installation of a new 3-phase distribution board with MCB protection; replacement of all light fixtures with LED luminaires; installation of 8 ceiling fans and 4 exhaust fans; provision of 12 new 5-amp and 6 new 15-amp power sockets; earthing of the entire installation as per IS 3043.

c) **Sanitary Works:** Replacement of all sanitary fixtures in the men's and women's toilets; replacement of concealed water supply lines in the toilet blocks; repair of leaking drainage lines; installation of 2 new water heaters; provision of new CPVC hot and cold water lines from the overhead tank to the kitchen and toilets.

d) **Interior Finishing and Painting:** Removal of existing flaking paint from internal walls and ceilings; application of one coat of primer and two coats of acrylic emulsion paint to internal walls; application of two coats of synthetic enamel paint to all doors, windows, and grills; polishing of the existing granite flooring in the main hall; replacement of damaged ceramic tiles in the kitchen and toilets; repair and repainting of the stage flooring.

**3.2 Exclusions**

The following works are excluded from the scope and shall be carried out by the Owner at its own cost:

a) Supply and installation of furniture, curtains, and stage lighting;
b) Supply and installation of air-conditioning units;
c) Any civil works outside the community hall building, including paving of the surrounding area.

**4. TIME OF COMPLETION**

4.1 The Contractor shall commence the works within 10 days of the date of receipt of the mobilization advance and shall complete the entire works within **120 days** from the date of commencement, subject to force majeure and other delays attributable to the Owner.

4.2 The time for completion shall be extended by the Owner in case of any delay caused by the Owner, including but not limited to delay in providing drawings, approvals, or access to the site, or any change in the scope of work.

4.3 If the Contractor fails to complete the works within the stipulated period, excluding the extended period, the Contractor shall pay to the Owner liquidated damages at the rate of 0.5% of the contract amount per week of delay, subject to a maximum of 10% of the contract amount. Such liquidated damages shall be the only remedy available to the Owner for delay in completion.

**5. CONTRACT PRICE AND PAYMENT TERMS**

5.1 The total contract price for the execution of the entire scope of work shall be **₹18,00,000 (Rupees Eighteen Lakh Only)**, hereinafter referred to as the "Contract Price." The Contract Price is fixed and shall not be subject to escalation for any reason whatsoever, except as provided in Clause 5.5 below.

5.2 The Contract Price shall be paid to the Contractor in the following instalments:

a) **Mobilization Advance:** 20% of the Contract Price, i.e., ₹3,60,000, payable within 7 days of execution of this Agreement and upon submission of an unconditional bank guarantee from a scheduled commercial bank for an equivalent amount. The mobilization advance shall be recovered by way of deduction from the running account bills at the rate of 10% of the gross amount of each bill.

b) **Running Account Bills:** 75% of the Contract Price shall be paid through running account bills raised at the end of each month. Each running account bill shall be accompanied by a certificate from the Owner's engineer quantifying the work executed during the month. The Owner shall make payment of each running account bill within 15 days of receipt of the certificate from the engineer.

c) **Retention Money:** 5% of the Contract Price, i.e., ₹90,000, shall be retained from each running account bill. Fifty percent of the retention money shall be released upon issuance of the completion certificate, and the balance shall be released upon expiry of the defect liability period, subject to the Contractor rectifying all defects noticed during such period.

d) **Final Bill:** The final bill shall be submitted within 30 days of issuance of the completion certificate. The final bill shall be paid within 30 days of its certification by the Owner's engineer.

5.3 All payments shall be made by cheque or electronic transfer to the bank account of the Contractor, details of which are provided in Annexure II.

5.4 The Contractor shall be liable to pay interest at the rate of 12% per annum on any amount that becomes due and payable to the Owner under this Agreement, if not paid within the stipulated time.

5.5 The Contract Price may be varied only in the following circumstances:

a) If the Owner issues a written variation order for additional work not covered under the scope of work, the price for such additional work shall be mutually agreed upon prior to execution;

b) If the Owner omits any part of the scope of work, the price shall be reduced proportionately at the rates quoted in the Bill of Quantities;

c) If the statutory duties or taxes are increased or decreased after the date of signing of this Agreement, the difference shall be adjusted accordingly.

**Report on the Audit of the Financial Statements**

**Opinion**

We have audited the accompanying financial statements of Jayanagar Residents Welfare Association (“the Association”), which comprise the Balance Sheet as at 31 March 2022, the Income and Expenditure Account for the year then ended, and notes to the financial statements, including a summary of significant accounting policies.

In our opinion and to the best of our information and according to the explanations given to us, the aforesaid financial statements give a true and fair view in conformity with the accounting principles generally accepted in India, of the state of affairs of the Association as at 31 March 2022 and its surplus for the year ended on that date, subject to our observations in the Basis for Qualified Opinion paragraph below.

**Basis for Qualified Opinion**

The Association maintains its books of account on a cash basis. During the course of our audit, we observed that certain expenditure transactions amounting to ₹4,82,350 (previous year: ₹3,15,700) were recorded in the books based on payment advices and bank statements, but the corresponding original receipts/invoices from the vendors were not made available for our verification. In the absence of the original supporting documents, we are unable to comment on the completeness, accuracy, and genuineness of these expenditures. The audit report shows that the Audit Report FY 2021-22 has an audit_opinion of qualified. Record status: current.

We conducted our audit in accordance with the Standards on Auditing (SAs) issued by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI). Our responsibilities under those Standards are further described in the “Auditor’s Responsibilities for the Audit of the Financial Statements” section of our report. We are independent of the Association in accordance with the Code of Ethics issued by the ICAI, and we have fulfilled our other ethical responsibilities in accordance with the Code.

We believe that the audit evidence we have obtained is sufficient and appropriate to provide a basis for our qualified opinion.

**Key Audit Matters**

Key audit matters are those matters that, in our professional judgment, were of most significance in our audit of the financial statements of the current period. These matters were addressed in the context of our audit of the financial statements as a whole, and in forming our opinion thereon, and we do not provide a separate opinion on these matters. We have determined that there are no key audit matters to communicate in our report.

**Information Other than the Financial Statements and Auditor’s Report Thereon**

The Management Committee of the Association is responsible for the other information. The other information comprises the information included in the Annual Report, but does not include the financial statements and our auditor’s report thereon. Our opinion on the financial statements does not cover the other information and we do not express any form of assurance conclusion thereon. In connection with our audit of the financial statements, our responsibility is to read the other information and, in doing so, consider whether the other information is materially inconsistent with the financial statements or our knowledge obtained in the audit or otherwise appears to be materially misstated. If, based on the work we have performed, we conclude that there is a material misstatement of this other information, we are required to report that fact. We have nothing to report in this regard.
